summary: Completed comprehensive end-to-end testing of Warehouse Management System Phase 2 (login + role selection + owner staff management). All backend APIs and frontend flows are working perfectly.
passed_tests: Backend: POST /api/auth/login with valid owner credentials returns JWT token + user object (200)
Backend: POST /api/auth/login rejects wrong password with 401
Backend: POST /api/auth/login rejects role mismatch with 403
Backend: GET /api/auth/me requires Authorization Bearer header and returns current user (200)
Backend: POST /api/owner/staff creates staff user (Owner only) with valid roles (201)
Backend: POST /api/owner/staff rejects non-owner JWT with 403
Backend: POST /api/owner/staff rejects duplicate email with 409
Backend: GET /api/owner/staff lists all staff (Owner only) (200)
Backend: DELETE /api/owner/staff/{id} removes staff user (200)
Backend: Newly created staff can login via /api/auth/login with their role (200)
Backend: All three staff roles (warehouse, data_entry, verification) can be created successfully
Frontend: Role selection landing page shows 4 role cards (data-testid: role-card-owner/warehouse/data-entry/verification)
Frontend: Clicking Owner card navigates to /login/owner showing the login form
Frontend: Logging in as owner (owner@warehouse.com / Owner@123) lands on /dashboard/owner with welcome heading
Frontend: Owner can create staff via Add staff form (data-testids: staff-name, staff-email, staff-password, staff-role, create-staff-btn)
Frontend: New staff row appears in staff list (data-testid: staff-row-{email})
Frontend: Owner can delete staff (data-testid: delete-staff-{email}); confirm() dialog accepted automatically
Frontend: Logout button (data-testid: logout-btn) returns user to /login role selection
Frontend: After login, page refresh keeps user logged in (JWT persisted in localStorage as wms_token)
Frontend: Wrong password shows error message (data-testid: login-error) on /login/owner
Frontend: Role mismatch error shown when staff tries to login under wrong role
